CMAKE_MINIMUM_REQUIRED(VERSION 3.12.0 FATAL_ERROR)

IF(NOT DEFINED FXG_ROOT_DIR)
    MESSAGE(FATAL_ERROR "The project should be built from the top-level directory.")
ENDIF()

SET(PROJECT_NAME glm)
PROJECT(${PROJECT_NAME} CXX C)

FILE(GLOB MAIN_FILES ./*.hpp ./*.cppm)
FILE(GLOB SIMD_FILES ./simd/*.h)
FILE(GLOB GTX_FILES ./gtx/*.hpp ./gtx/*.inl)
FILE(GLOB GTC_FILES ./gtc/*.hpp ./gtc/*.inl)
FILE(GLOB EXT_FILES ./ext/*.hpp ./ext/*.inl)
FILE(GLOB DETAIL_FILES ./detail/*.hpp ./detail/*.inl)

SOURCE_GROUP(main FILES
    ${MAIN_FILES}
)

SOURCE_GROUP(simd FILES
    ${SIMD_FILES}
)

SOURCE_GROUP(gtx FILES
    ${GTX_FILES}
)

SOURCE_GROUP(gtc FILES
    ${GTC_FILES}
)

SOURCE_GROUP(ext FILES
    ${EXT_FILES}
)

SOURCE_GROUP(detail FILES
    ${DETAIL_FILES}
)

ADD_LIBRARY(${PROJECT_NAME} STATIC
    ${MAIN_FILES}
    ${SIMD_FILES}
    ${GTX_FILES}
    ${GTC_FILES}
    ${EXT_FILES}
    ${DETAIL_FILES}
)

TARGET_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
)

TARGET_LINK_LIBRARIES(${PROJECT_NAME}
)

SET_TARGET_PROPERTIES(${PROJECT_NAME} PROPERTIES LINKER_LANGUAGE CXX)
SET_TARGET_PROPERTIES(${PROJECT_NAME} PROPERTIES FOLDER "thirdparty")
